about: Every source the Ford build draws on (claude/plans/air-ford.md). use: trace = may be traced and matched; facts = its facts may be cited, its figures are never traced into the repository; look = looked at only. Photos are of CVN-78 herself unless their entry says otherwise. fetch.py downloads each entry with a url into references/ and checks its hash; a volatile entry is a web page, whose hash records the copy its facts were read from.

references.title: 2022 NOAA NGS Ortho-rectified 4-band Mosaic of Newport News & Norfolk/ Hampton Roads, Virginia (tile 381000e4092000n)
references.authors: NOAA National Geodetic Survey, Remote Sensing Division
references.licence: CC0-1.0: "These data were produced by NOAA and are not subject to copyright protection in the United States. NOAA waives any potential copyright and related rights in these data worldwide through the Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication (CC0-1.0)."
references.note: 0.25 m, 4 bands, EPSG:6347 (NAD83(2011) UTM zone 18N); mosaic NorfolkVA_RGBN_2022_EPSG-6347.vrt. The Ford alongside at Naval Station Norfolk, north side of the second carrier pier, stern west, in about E 381420-381860, N 4090700-4090900: deck nearly empty, markings sharp, 78 readable on the bow. Rectified to the water, so the deck (about 18-20 m up) scales by H/(H-h) and the island leans; mosaic seams cross the deck at about 40% and 70% of its length from the stern.
